name: Barramundi with Lemon and Dill

ingredients.name: barramundi fillets
ingredients.original: 4 barramundi fillets, skin on, about 180 g each

ingredients.name: lemon
ingredients.original: 1 lemon, half juiced and half cut into wedges

steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 15 minutes until tender, adding the beans for the last 3 minutes. Drain and keep warm.
Pat the barramundi dry and season the skin well — dry skin is the whole trick to crisp skin.
Heat the olive oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat and lay the fillets in skin side down, pressing each one flat for a few seconds.
Cook for 4 minutes without moving them, until the skin releases and is deep gold, then turn and cook for 1 minute more. Lift onto plates, skin up.
Drop the butter and capers into the hot pan, let the butter foam and brown, then take it off the heat and stir in the lemon juice and dill.
Spoon the pan sauce over the potatoes and beans, and serve the fish with the lemon wedges.
